extraction.title: Buttonwood
extraction.subtitle: A global fight over banking rules is just getting started Co-operation on the financial system will be the casualty
extraction.summary: The global banking system faces a potential crisis as the U.S. and Europe diverge on capital requirements, risking a competitive disadvantage for European banks. Recent U.S. regulatory changes could lead to increased leverage in the banking sector, while European regulators respond with their own adjustments. This trend towards deregulation may heighten the risk of financial instability.
